Hello Oleg,

Thank you for your message and interest in our platform. We do accept guest
posts and other advertising opportunities at DroidAfrica.

Guest posts are accepted at the rate of $100 per article.

Link insertion is available at $80 per link.

Homepage ad placement is $500 per month.

Casino/crypto/betting at $200

For casino, vape, CBD, and similar content, the rate is $1,000 per article
or link.
links on the home page or in the footer accepted at $1,000 per month
Banner accepted at $1,000 per month

Please note that our guest posts are not labeled "Sponsored," all external
links are "do-follow," and the links are permanent. Payment is accepted
through PayPal.

We look forward to working with you.



Warm Regards

Kenneth O

For Droid Africa

How to Fix It
The address may be misspelled or may not exist. Try one or more of the following:

  *   Send the message again following these steps: In Outlook, open this non-delivery report (NDR) and choose Send Again from the Report ribbon. In Outlook on the web, select this NDR, then select the link "To send this message again, click here." Then delete and retype the entire recipient address. If prompted with an Auto-Complete List suggestion don't select it. After typing the complete address, click Send.
  *   Contact the recipient (by phone, for example) to check that the address exists and is correct.
  *   The recipient may have set up email forwarding to an incorrect address. Ask them to check that any forwarding they've set up is working correctly.
  *   Clear the recipient Auto-Complete List in Outlook or Outlook on the web by following the steps in this article: Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.10 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=532972>, and then send the message again. Retype the entire recipient address before selecting Send.

More Info for Email Admins
Status code: 550 5.1.10

This error occurs because the sender sent a message to an email address hosted by Office 365 but the address is incorrect or doesn't exist at the destination domain. The error is reported by the recipient domain's email server, but most often it must be fixed by the person who sent the message. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

The email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - If you have a hybrid environment and are using directory synchronization make sure the recipient's email address is synced correctly in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Errant forwarding rule - Check for forwarding rules that aren't behaving as expected. Forwarding can be set up by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Inbox Rules feature.

Recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license (Users > Active Users > select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Mail flow settings and MX records are not correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are configured correctly.

For more information and additional tips to fix this issue, see Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.10 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=532972>.

Type	Branding
Level	Primary Goal & Description	Surcharge
Type I	Non-Branded	Goal:AUTHORITY.
Purely technical/educational. Link is for SEO
value with no brand focus in the surrounding text.	+0%
(Base Price)
Type II	Semi-Branded	Goal:TRAFFIC.
Primarily educational, but your brand/product appears
once or twice as a relevant example or case study.	+50%
of Base Price
Type III	Fully Branded	Goal:BRANDING.
Focused entirely on your brand (e.g., review,
guide, listicle, interview, or company profile).	+100%of Base Price

💰 Pricing Formula

$$(Base\ Price) + (Base\ Price \times Surcharge\ Rate)$$

> 💡Example:If you want aFinance Link (Tier 4)for aReview Article (Type III):
>
> -
>
> Base Price:$450 (Tier 4)
>
> -
>
> Surcharge:$450$\times$100% = $450
>
> -
>
> Total Price:$450 + $450 =$900 USD

** 📊 Fact of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

A post from Lily Ray (https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7434978494960500736/?commentUrn=urn%3Ali%3Acomment%3A&utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=b9726624e4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_03_05_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-b9726624e4-1449626676(activity%3A7434978494960500736%2C7435015801948078099)&dashCommentUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afsd_comment%3A(7435015801948078099%2Curn%3Ali%3Aactivity%3A7434978494960500736)) highlighted that some AI Search companies are paying people to post promotional messages claiming that GEO is the future and SEO is dead.

🧐 Why should you care?

Really, it’s just another reminder that what you see out there isn’t always the truth.

💡 What should you do about it?

Be mindful of the advice you hear online. Just because someone says something doesn’t make it true. Look for data to support your choices and decisions.

Also, don’t run to the first shiny tool or tactic that looks appealing. Remember, most people on social only share the good stuff, never the bad.

What works for one site rarely works for every site.


** 🐝 Tip of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

Have you checked out Pinterest Trends (https://trends.pinterest.com/?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=b9726624e4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_03_05_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-b9726624e4-1449626676) yet?

If not, you are missing out on potential content and reactive PR ideas.

For reactive PR, trends are a fantastic way to get your brand or experts in front of journalists and writers covering similar stories.

Pitches like: “‘Hot Pot Ideas’ is trending on Pinterest and we wanted to share our expert chef’s do’s and don’t’s,” along with some custom tips for a story, can get you quick features in certain publications.

This is especially common in some UK publications. A search for “food + expert reveals” uncovered this piece from DailyMail (https://www.dailymail.co.uk/lifestyle/food-drink/article-15505435/From-reheating-rice-scrambled-egg-prep-food-expert-reveals-13-common-kitchen-myths-ignore.html?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=b9726624e4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_03_05_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-b9726624e4-1449626676) .

Or here is a Thanksgiving-themes experts piece from Fox News (https://www.foxnews.com/food-drink/stop-carb-overload-experts-expose-hidden-reason-big-meals-backfire-how-protein-flips-switch?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=b9726624e4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_03_05_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-b9726624e4-1449626676) .

The trick is to frame the pitch alongside the trend so the journalist understands it is timely.

Trending item + expert tip = more likelihood of coverage.

But remember, these journalists have access to Pinterest too. That’s where the tips come in. They provide extra value that the journalist might not readily be able to get.

Extra points if you can also include proprietary data.

For example, if “hot pot ideas” is trending and your brand offers cooking classes, there may also be proprietary data showing that hot pot classes are up 50%.

Then you have something even better.

So far, the site features the titular Bic mechanical pencil (the name of the website), the PEZ dispenser, the Zippo lighter, and a Pilot retractable pen.

------------------------------------------------------------

Mental + what = enticing story?

Mental health + dating = bingo!

There are many sites that cover relationships and dating, and it’s even a strong hook for lifestyle journalists.

The only thing that would probably have made this even more pitchable was a tie-in with Mental Health Awareness Month in the US in May (but hey, this is a relatively evergreen study, so they could re-pitch in May).

QuickReads Welcome to Miami Living Magazine’s newsletter— a round up of happenings and smart reads.

Good morning! Miami welcomes March with festivals, tennis, culture, and travel inspiration. From Carnaval and the Miami Open to orchids, music, rare whiskies, and global escapes, there’s something for every taste.

Orchids in Bloom Festival at Fairchild Tropical Garden. Photo/Leonie Clough

Happenings March in Miami opens with Carnaval on the Mile on March 7–8, filling Miracle Mile with world music, art, crafts and food. The New World Symphony’s March concert series features full-orchestra and chamber programs, and a Violin Concerto, which also begins on March 7. More classical music is happening on March 14 when Joshua Bell performs with the Academy of St Martin at the Adrienne Arsht Center. Dog Mom Walk brings pups and their owners together for an oceanfront gathering along the Miami Beach boardwalk on March 14. And there is also the beautiful Orchids in Bloom Festival, which will fill Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden with 150,000 orchids on March 14–15. Tennis With the world’s best players coming to Miami for two weeks of competition at the Miami Open, we’ve created a special guide with everything you need: ticket info, schedule, parking, off-court events, food, and more. Plus, we sit down with some of the biggest tennis names, including Alex de Minaur, Amanda Anisimova, Ben Shelton, Coco Gauff, Frances Tiafoe, Jakub Mensik, Jannik Sinner, Taylor Fritz, and more for personal insights on Miami and life on tour. Taste of Tennis Miami takes place on March 16, offering the chance to mingle with tennis pros while enjoying food and drinks, hosted by Miami’s own DJ Irie. Food We bring you rare and some of the world’s most expensive Scotch whiskies from The Macallan, The Dalmore, Bowmore, and Glenfiddich, with bottles reaching from $250,000 to several million dollars.

People We sat down with Ice-T to reflect on the birth of gangsta rap, his decades on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, and the balance between career longevity and family life Insights Moul Dey, Professor of Nutrition Science at the South Dakota State University, shows a new research that suggests diets with fewer ultra-processed foods and more whole ingredients supports healthier aging. Emily Messina, Associate Professor of Rehabilitation and Recreational Therapy at Florida International University, shares how hobbies like yoga, rock climbing, and even tabletop role-playing games like Dungeons & Dragons can strengthen overall wellbeing.

The Andes Mountains in Mendoza, Argentina. Photo by Nicolas Perez/Unsplash

Travel We take you to the Malbec vineyards of Mendoza, Argentina, and on to the eco-luxury seclusion of Playa Cativo Lodge in Costa Rica for an immersive rainforest escape. Magazine For those who value speed and style on the ground, Miami Living presents the Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut. In the skies, Gulfstream introduces the G800, the world’s longest-range business jet, reaching speeds of up to Mach 0.935. As always, thank you for taking the time to read Miami Living!

Sehr geehrte Geschäftspartner,

sehr gerne nehmen wir Ihr Advertorial im Bereich Ratgeber unter https://www.dzonline.de/Ratgeber (oder im Menü unter Ratgeber) auf. Hier finden Sie verschiedene Themengebiete, in die eigentlich alle Ratgeberartikel passen.

Sie müssten uns ein Word-Dokument mit dem Text sowie allen gewünschten Links und Bildern - inkl. Angabe der Bildrechte - zur Verfügung stellen (wir erstellen keine Artikel und ergänzen auch keine Links oder Bilder). PDF-Dokumente bedeuten einen erhöhten Zeitaufwand, den wir gerne vermeiden möchten. Bitte beachten Sie, keine Links in den Teaser zu verbauen, da unser System diese nicht verarbeiten kann und der Link somit automatisch entfernt wird. Somit bitte immer einen kurzen Teaser ohne Link senden.

Die Artikel sind dezent mit dem Wort „Sonderveröffentlichung“ gekennzeichnet (Beispiel siehe hier<https://www.dzonline.de/duelmen/letzter-dz-scheck-geht-nach-buldern-3200659>), die Links sind „dofollow“.

Die Preise belaufen sich fix auf 250 Euro für 2 Jahre, 350 Euro für 4 Jahre oder 450 Euro ohne Befristung zzgl. MwSt. pro Advertorial. Für die Kategorien Online-Gaming, Online-Glücksspiel und Krypto gilt der doppelte Preis, also 500 Euro für 2 Jahre, 700 Euro für 4 Jahre oder 900 Euro ohne Befristung zzgl. MwSt. pro Advertorial.

Sie können per Überweisung oder PayPal zahlen. Ganz wichtig ist, dass bei Zahlung ein Verweis auf den Artikel angegeben wird, um die Zahlung richtig zuordnen zu können. Rechnungen werden in der Regel einmal monatlich erstellt und an Sie verschickt.

Wir behalten uns selbstverständlich die Prüfung des Textes und eine Nichtveröffentlichung vor. Prinzipiell gilt die Einschränkung: Artikel zu allen Suchmitteln wie Zigaretten, Cannabis, Vapes etc. und erotischen Inhalten veröffentlichen wir nicht.

Bevor wir mit dem ersten Artikel starten, benötigen wir zwingend Ihre Firmen- bzw. Rechnungsadresse inkl. aller relevanten Daten (z.B. Steuernummer EU), um eine Prüfung durchzuführen. Sollten diese Daten nicht vollständig vorliegen, ist eine Veröffentlichung nicht möglich. Sollte dann alles okay sein, wird der Artikel innerhalb von 6 Werktagen veröffentlicht.

Bei Rückfragen stehen wir gerne zur Verfügung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Gabriel McKiernan

   - *The DR of your website should be above 25*
   - *Only relevant text edits will be accepted*
   - *We can provide links only from the blog page*
   - *We do not provide links in the intro or conclusion paragraphs*
   - *We provide links only to tech or SaaS-related pages*
   - *The price for a link insertion is $90*


Please note that both guest posts and links will be permanent and
do-follow, without a sponsored tag.

As a payment method, we prefer to proceed with PayPal, and the turnaround
time (TAT) for both guest posts and link insertions is 2 working days.

information.

How to Fix It
The address may be misspelled or may not exist. Try one or more of the following:

  *   Send the message again following these steps: In Outlook, open this non-delivery report (NDR) and choose Send Again from the Report ribbon. In Outlook on the web, select this NDR, then select the link "To send this message again, click here." Then delete and retype the entire recipient address. If prompted with an Auto-Complete List suggestion don't select it. After typing the complete address, click Send.
  *   Contact the recipient (by phone, for example) to check that the address is correct.
  *   The recipient may have set up email forwarding to an incorrect address. Ask them to check that any forwarding they've set up is working correctly.
  *   Clear the recipient Auto-Complete List in Outlook or Outlook on the web by following the steps in this article: Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.1 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=389363>, and then send the message again. Retype the entire recipient address before selecting Send.

Was this helpful? Send feedback to Microsoft<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=618497>.
________________________________

More Info for Email Admins
Status code 554 5.4.14

Typically this error occurs because the recipient email address is incorrect or doesn't exist at the destination domain. This can usually be fixed by the sender. However, sometimes the issue needs to be fixed by the recipient or the recipient's email admin. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

The email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - If you have a hybrid environment and are using directory synchronization make sure the recipient's email address is synced correctly in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Errant forwarding rule - Check for forwarding rules that aren't behaving as expected. A forwarding rule can be configured by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Inbox Rules feature.

Mail flow settings and MX records are not correct - Misconfigured mail flow settings or MX records can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are configured correctly.

Mail loop detected - This error also indicates that the receiving organization's email settings are misconfigured, creating a mail loop when a message is sent to an address that isn't found in their directory. This usually won't disrupt mail flow for recipients that actually exist, but the recipient's email admin should fix the misconfiguration to reduce the chance of any other mail flow issues. A common cause for this loop is that the recipient's domain is configured as "Internal Relay" when it should be "Authoritative." Another common cause for the loop is that both the sender and recipient are part of the same organization, but the sender's mailbox is hosted by Office 365, while the recipient's mailbox is hosted on-premises, and an outbound connector from Office 365 to the on-premises email servers is missing or misconfigured. To fix this, the recipient's email admin should create a correctly configured outbound connector in Office 365 to route the message to the on-premises mailbox.

For more information and tips to fix this problem, see Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.4.14 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=397497>.

Hello, these are the article publishing prices.
Price for publishing a permanent article with only one "Dofollow" link
(regular content) = $60
Price for publishing a permanent article with only one "Dofollow" link
(sports content) = $90
Price for publishing a permanent article with only one "Dofollow" link
(trading, casino, Crypto, and betting content) = $180

Notes:
- CBD is rejected
- Any additional link in the article will cost 50% of the article price.
- By 'content,' it means the content of the link in the article, not the
content of the article itself.
- Payment must be made within 24 hours of publishing the article to avoid
deletion
- Payment is available via PayPal or USDT(TRC20)
- If you choose to pay via PayPal: the transfer fees will be added to the
invoice (PayPal deducts them from us 5%).
- If you choose to pay via USDT(TRC20): no transfer fees

From: press@hugerugby.news
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 13:46:06 +0100
Subject: Re: Collaboration with hugerugby.news

Thank you for reaching out directly to us. We are indeed open to new 
collaborations.

Our guest post fee is 99€ with a surcharge of 50€ for a gambling/betting 
link. Find enclosed, the completed list of our websites and services:

💰 Guest Post Fees
Hugerugby.news (English, Rugby/Sports) - €99
Samsung-actu.fr ( French, Tech/High-Tech) - €29
Manga-online.fr ( French, Manga) - €19
Littlecam.fr ( French, Photo/Video) -   €29
Escrimeur.fr ( French, Sport/Fencing) - €19
Gambling / Casino / Crypto links are accepted with a +€50 surcharge.

In addition to guest posts, we also offer banners or sitewide links on 
our websites. Availability, placement, and pricing can be discussed 
individually to best suit your campaign goals.

🎁 Bulk discount: -30% for 5 links or more (can mix different websites).

📋 What’s Included
✅ Dofollow backlink
✅ Lifetime placement (no removals)
✅ Not marked as “sponsored”
✅ Homepage visibility upon publication
✅ Link insertions can be done on existing articles
✅ We can write the article for you (free of charge)
✅ Delivery time is 24/48h

🧾 How to Proceed
Please reply with:

The website(s) you’re interested in
Your proposed topic
The URL and anchor text you’d like to include
Whether you’ll provide the article or prefer that we write it
Once confirmed, we’ll provide a publication timeline and payment 
details.

💳 Payment Methods
We accept both PayPal and bank transfer.

Best regards,

Mike

** 📊 Fact of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

Kevin Indiig just published a study (https://www.growth-memo.com/p/the-science-of-how-ai-pays-attention?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676) that tried to answer the question of what ChatGPT cites from a page.

He found that ~45% of all citations come from the first 30% of text.

🧐 Why should you care?

Understanding how AI interacts with a page can help influence how you format the information.

And although you shouldn’t necessarily tailor your content for a bot, it can help highlight structure.

💡 What should you do about it?

As Kevin says in the article, “The AI reads like a journalist. It grabs the “Who, What, Where” from the top. If your key insight is in the intro, the chances it gets cited are high.”

So, don’t bury the key information.


** 🐝 Tip of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

With any pitch, if you can’t answer “what’s the story?” you are going to have a hard time getting through to a journalist.

Your study or product announcement typically isn’t the story.

Think about the last article you read about a new restaurant opening.

It’s rarely just about an opening. It’s about the founder’s origins. Or the old restaurant it’s replacing.

Sometimes you can create a story or trend and connect your product that way.

This press release from Lysol (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/when-flu-norovirus-covid-19-and-the-common-cold-collide-introducing-flunorococo-season-this-winter-302689884.html?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676) highlights a trend they are calling “flunorococo.” (which is when FLU, NOrovirus, COvid, AND Common COld circulate simultaneously).

The Lysol spray itself is the answer to the issue.

It solves the problem/trend presented, but it’s not the spotlight.


** 💡Content Roundup
------------------------------------------------------------

Here are some inspiring, interesting, creative campaigns I’ve found from across the internet.


** 1. Product Partnership: Lego Crocs
------------------------------------------------------------

🔗 Link (https://www.lego.com/en-us/product/brick-clog-5010203?CMP=AFC-AffiliateUS-US9P%2F9RI%2FvA-2860710-1606623-10&utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676)

LEGO and Crocs partnered to make LEGO Crocs.

Product partnerships can be great vehicles for press. But any time you can partner outside your niche, you'll get a lot more reach.

The shoe market, specifically, is huge, as is fashion in general, so this partnership has a much broader, diverse reach than if they stayed in the toy lane.

Plus, who doesn’t love LEGO?


** 2. Reddit’s Dove Partnership
------------------------------------------------------------

🔗 Link (https://www.dove.com/us/en/campaigns/products/reddit-said-it.html?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676)

Dove partnered with Reddit to display reviews of its mask product.

They put up the reviews (good and bad) as billboards in NYC during fashion week earlier this month.

We’ve seen this reviews thing before (remember the Ikea sleep reviews (https://www.adweek.com/creativity/ikea-taps-real-sleep-talkers-for-dreamy-mattress-endorsements/?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676) ?), but this one takes some real faith in your brand.

It seems to have gone over well, as people appreciate the transparency, which is somewhat part of Dove’s brand.

It’s still unclear whether publicizing a review that says it smells “like an old lady” will impact sales…


** 3. Reuters’ home insurance scrollytelling story
------------------------------------------------------------

🔗 Link (https://www.reuters.com/graphics/USA-ECONOMY/FAIR-INSURANCE/lgpdqnqamvo/?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676)

Reuters consistently puts out amazing graphics and data visualizations. This scrollytelling (yes, it’s a real term, look it up) explains how wildfire insurance through FAIR plans is spreading thin as risk increases in these counties.

Is this approach for everyone? Probably not.

But if you are looking for a way to differentiate or even just change it up, these can stand out.


** 4. X’s $1M Article content
------------------------------------------------------------

🔗 Link (https://x.com/XCreators/status/2018803490504774059?s=20&utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676)

I don’t spend a lot of time on X anymore, but I thought this blunt-force marketing technique was … interesting.

To support the launch of their new “Articles” feature, which is almost like a Medium/Substack layout, they launched a contest offering a $1M prize to the winner of the best article based on:

* Adherence to submission guidelines;
* Grammar, spelling, and technical proficiency;
* Originality and authenticity; and
* Platform engagement (i.e., verified Home Timeline impressions).

The content itself, as well as the winner, got press, good and bad.


** 5. Orkin’s Mosquito City Study
------------------------------------------------------------

🔗 Link (https://www.orkin.com/press-room/mosquito-season-top-cities-los-angeles-ranked-first?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676)

Orkin’s 2025 Mosquito Season study is essentially a city study ranking the cities with the most number of new residential mosquito treatments performed by Orkin.

This is an exemplary example of a city study because it both ties to a business goal and uses proprietary data.

It’s also something they’ve repeated year in and year out, giving them the ability to also look at trends.

Bravo.

s/o to Matt Seabridge’s Digital PR Observer (https://www.digitalprtips.com/newsletter/the-digital-pr-observer-newsletter-issue-60?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=f38b3ea81d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_02_19_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-f38b3ea81d-1449626676) for this one.

That’s it for this week. If you have any campaigns you would like to share, DM me, or reply to this email to let me know!

Thread ID: 19c6e2e307d890a5
Subject: Cursor Updates: Plugins, Sandbox Access Controls, and More
Messages: 1

=== Message 1 ===
From: Cursor Team <team@mail.cursor.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 00:37:26 +0000

Hi Oleg,

In Cursor 2.5, we introduced plugins for extending Cursor, improvements to core agent capabilities like subagents, and fine-grained network controls for sandboxed commands.

Plugins on the Cursor Marketplace

Cursor now supports plugins ( https://cursor.com/docs/plugins ), allowing agents to connect to external tools and learn new knowledge. Plugins bundle capabilities like MCP servers, skills, subagents, rules, and hooks that extend agents with custom functionality.

We’re starting with a highly curated set from partners such as Amplitude, AWS, Figma, Linear, and Stripe. These plugins span the product development lifecycle, allowing Cursor to deploy services, implement payments, run advanced testing, and more.

Explore Cursor Marketplace ( https://cursor.com/marketplace )
You can discover and install prebuilt plugins on the Cursor Marketplace ( https://cursor.com/marketplace ) or create your own and share them with the community.

Read more in our announcement ( https://cursor.com/blog/marketplace ).

Sandbox network access controls

The sandbox ( https://cursor.com/docs/agent/terminal#sandbox-configuration ) now supports granular network access controls, as well as controls for access to directories and files on your local filesystem. Define exactly which domains the agent is allowed to reach while running sandboxed commands.

Admins on the Enterprise plan can enforce network allowlists and denylists from the admin dashboard ( https://cursor.com/dashboard ), ensuring organization-wide egress policies apply to all agent sandbox sessions.

Async subagents

Previously, all subagents ( https://cursor.com/docs/context/subagents ) ran synchronously, blocking the parent agent until they complete. Subagents can now run asynchronously, allowing the parent to continue working while subagents run in the background.

Subagents can also spawn their own subagents, creating a tree of coordinated work. This allows Cursor to take on bigger tasks like multi-file features, large refactors, and challenging bugs.

Learn about everything new in Cursor 2.5 ( https://cursor.com/changelog/2-5 ), including performance improvements to subagents, chat history as context, and more.

Best,
Cursor Team

Из-за неверного учета командировочных расходов В 2026 налоговые проверки стали жестче из-за изменений в законах. Под пристальное внимание попадают и не самые очевидные расходы компаний, например, на командировки. Как верно подтверждать эти траты, чтобы избежать штрафов? Рассказывает финансовый директор Smartway Артур Павлов в бесплатном гайде для руководителей и бухгалтеров. Скачать файл Вы узнаете: Какие риски связаны с документами по проезду сотрудников в 2026 году. Как правильно оформить непредвиденные ситуации в командировке: отмену рейса, штрафы за возврат и изменение маршрута. Какие командировочные документы точно не примет налоговая. Даже при хорошо выстроенных процессах по поездкам в компании ошибки в проездных документах встречаются почти в каждом авансовом отчете. ✍️ Скачивайте гайд и используйте его в компании. How to Fix It
The address may be misspelled or may not exist. Try one or more of the following:

  *   Send the message again following these steps: In Outlook, open this non-delivery report (NDR) and choose Send Again from the Report ribbon. In Outlook on the web, select this NDR, then select the link "To send this message again, click here." Then delete and retype the entire recipient address. If prompted with an Auto-Complete List suggestion don't select it. After typing the complete address, click Send.
  *   Contact the recipient (by phone, for example) to check that the address exists and is correct.
  *   The recipient may have set up email forwarding to an incorrect address. Ask them to check that any forwarding they've set up is working correctly.
  *   Clear the recipient Auto-Complete List in Outlook or Outlook on the web by following the steps in this article: Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.10 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=532972>, and then send the message again. Retype the entire recipient address before selecting Send.

More Info for Email Admins
Status code: 550 5.1.10

This error occurs because the sender sent a message to an email address hosted by Office 365 but the address is incorrect or doesn't exist at the destination domain. The error is reported by the recipient domain's email server, but most often it must be fixed by the person who sent the message. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

The email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - If you have a hybrid environment and are using directory synchronization make sure the recipient's email address is synced correctly in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Errant forwarding rule - Check for forwarding rules that aren't behaving as expected. Forwarding can be set up by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Inbox Rules feature.

Recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license (Users > Active Users > select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Mail flow settings and MX records are not correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are configured correctly.

For more information and additional tips to fix this issue, see Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.10 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=532972>.

Hello Oleg,

We can publish your guest articles on *atuvu.ca <http://atuvu.ca>*.

The price per article is *535 USD* or *450 EUR*. Each article will remain
online for at least *2 years*, without a sponsor tag, and may include
do-follow links.

Articles must be written in *good French* and cover topics relevant to our
readership: art, culture, entertainment, cinema, concerts, gastronomy,
theatre, family activities, design, literature, etc. Creativity is strongly
encouraged!

Here are a few examples:

   -


   https://atuvu.ca/fil-culturel-actualite-culturelle/culture-et-societe/comment-la-pandemie-faconne-lavenir-du-theatre-et-du-streaming-de-films-en-ligne
   <https://atuvu.ca/fil-culturel-actualite-culturelle/culture-et-societe/comment-la-pandemie-faconne-lavenir-du-theatre-et-du-streaming-de-films-en-ligne?utm_source=chatgpt.com>
   -


   https://www.atuvu.ca/fil-culturel-actualite-culturelle/divertissement/trois-films-a-suspense-a-redecouvrir-en-2022
   -


   https://www.atuvu.ca/fil-culturel-actualite-culturelle/divertissement/le-k-fiesta-montreal-fait-son-retour-en-2023

You may include any link of your choice. We prefer that the main subject
aligns with our regular themes, but we remain open to publishing an article
that goes a little off this line.

If you don’t have a French article ready, we can also publish an English
one.

Payment should be made preferably by *bank transfer* (or *PayPal* as a
second option), no later than the day after publication.

Does that sound good to you?

Best regards,

Arnaud N

* Did these customers use our solution?
* Did these customers come from beyond friends and family?

Subject: For every positive reply, you can get two more

From: Ziemek from Hunter <contact@mail.hunter.io>

-------------------------------------------
Balancing width and depth in email outreach
-------------------------------------------

We've analyzed the 2025 data, and there's a clear trend:

If you target 50 people with a single email sequence instead of 500, your reply rate will increase by 2.6x on average.

But... what about the remaining 450 recipients? You naturally want to contact every single prospect that might be interested in what you're offering.

The question is, how can your messaging stay hyper-relevant as you scale outreach?

Read more ( https://hunter.io/blog/balancing-width-and-depth-in-email-outreach/?utm_campaign=February+FN+Drip+%232&utm_content=February+FN+Drip+%232&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io )

----------------------------
How to segment your audience
----------------------------

Trenching means dividing a broad ICP into multiple narrow ICPs. It lets you reach a broad market while sending hyper-relevant campaigns.

Read more ( https://hunter.io/cold-email-guide/trenching-segmentation/?utm_campaign=February+FN+Drip+%232&utm_content=February+FN+Drip+%232&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io )

----------------------------------------
How to figure out who you should contact
----------------------------------------

Align your solution with your prospects' needs to start building a detailed ICP for your outreach sequences.

Read more ( https://hunter.io/cold-email-guide/value-proposition-canvas/?utm_campaign=February+FN+Drip+%232&utm_content=February+FN+Drip+%232&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io )

About Our Platform

Today we reach millions of monthly readers, with over 2.5 million followers
across our social channels. Our domain authority speaks for itself: Moz DA
85, Ahrefs DR 78, Spam Score 2. That combination puts us in the top 7% of
sites for quality guest placements.

What Makes Us Different

We're selective about what we publish — not every pitch gets accepted. Our
editorial team reviews every piece of content, and all links are do-follow
and never marked as sponsored. That selectivity protects link quality,
which is why placements with us continue delivering results years after
publication — and why we've maintained our authority through every Google
update, including the Helpful Content Update that wiped out many
lower-quality sites.

Our Pricing Structure

Sites at our authority level (DA 85, DR 78, Spam Score 2) typically charge
$1,000+ per placement. We use a simple two-tier system:

   -

   Standard Rates — Our published pricing, available to everyone.
   -

   Insiders Rates — 50% off Standard with a $50 annual membership. This is
   our best rate, and it's the same for everyone — no volume negotiations, no
   special deals.

For agencies and resellers: Standard is what you quote your clients.
Insiders is what you actually pay.

Hi Oleg, 

Yes, we do post guest posts under specific categories. Different categories have different requirements. 

Please see the list & pricing below: 

PRESS RELEASES: 

1. Press release (for crypto brands, tokens, pre-sale promos): $350 USD per press release, all links are no-follow, but do indexed by Google. All press releases go here: https://finbold.com/category/press-releases/

2. Press release (for established companies, SaaS brands, 'clean' press release with no pre-sale links, etc): $150 USD, all links are no-follow, but do indexed by Google. Also, published here: https://finbold.com/category/press-releases/

SPONSORED articles:

1. Sponsored category is purely reserved for 'sensitive' topics like casino, sports betting, forex, gambling. $800 USD per post, 1 do-follow link is allowed, do-indexed by Google. All content goes here: https://finbold.com/category/sponsored/

ORGANIC articles & REVIEWS: 

1. We call them organic 'guides' because we want to make the posts as natural as possible. We integrate client links into 'natural' way. For example, 'Is x {client's company} safe? 1,500 words, guide topics are discussed and
agreed prior to committing. 680 USD per post. 2 do-follow links are allowed, do-indexed by Google. This option is only for clean, established brands. No casinos, no forex trading, no crypto token promos. For this price, we can write content if needed. It's included in the price. Or, client can submit their own content. However, we might offer suggestions/edits to meet our editorial guidelines. 

2. Organic 'reviews'. $1460 USD. A longer form of content than organic 'guides. 3,500 words in depth review covering all
aspects of project. 2 do-follow links are allowed, do-indexed by Google. We produce this content, includes all research, edits, etc. Client reviews and approves final document via Google Docs. 

INTERVIEWS: 

1. All interviews go either here: https://finbold.com/category/interviews/ (Q&A format) or here https://finbold.com/category/opinions/ (Longer form content/ leader insights, opinion). Price per interview/opinion is $450 USD. We allow 1 do-follow link.

ALL OTHER THINGS:

1. For $450 USD we can rewrite press release (for clean brands) into a news posts. 
2. We accept link insertions for $300 USD per insertion. Not all content is available for insertions, it's decided on case by case basis. 

We can offer discounts on oder volume.

As well as: 

Review & 3 Supporting Guides (2590 EUR) or equivalent in USD, GBP
* 1 in-depth review of your project ~3,500 words
* 3 supporting guides ~1,200-1,500 words each
* 2 do-follow links to your website per review
* 1 do-follow link to your website per guide
* Marketing visuals (a poster with your company’s logo)
* Includes 1 revision
* Extra revisions may be subject to additional charges

Let me know if you have any other questions. 

Thanks

We appreciate your interest in gambling911.com. Below is a summary of our

Content and Pricing

We only accept gambling-related content, including crypto gambling. We
offer two options:
* You submit an article: The cost is $200 per publication. Your article
must be new, high-quality, and over 1,000 words, with no grammar or
spelling errors. It must be newsworthy, factual, and not contain emojis or
graphics. You can include one link to your client's website and at least

option guarantees inclusion in Google and is a great way to get
high-quality content that meets our editorial standards.

Please note: Our prices are firm, and we do not accept counter-offers or
requests for lower pricing.


Submission Policies

* AI and Spam: We do not accept content that is cut-and-paste, AI-driven,
or spam. Our editors are trained to detect this type of content and will
reject it.
* Editorial Revisions: Our editors will review and revise all submitted
articles to ensure they meet our standards. This includes updating the
article structure to avoid being flagged by Google, such as removing
subheadings like "CONCLUSION."
* Title Restrictions: Do not use the words "Review," "Bonus," "Most,"
"Worldwide," "Best," "Top," or "Guide" in your title. Titles must be
specific and not make general claims.
* Invoicing: All publications will be invoiced via PayPal after they are
published. Payment is due within 24 hours.
If you have any further questions, please let us know.

Hi Team,
Thank you for your interest in Durham Post - much appreciated.

Please note that we have paused accepting gambling orders until at least the end of March 2026.

We continue to accept other orders.

Please see our T&Cs and Rate List below:


  1.
Yes, we do welcome guest posts. We require you to write it and supply copyright-free illustrative landscape images. Guest Posts will have NO sponsored tags but will carry a 'supplied' byline.
  2.
We ask for a post with up to 1,000 words with a maximum of three links and three images. Each extra link will cost USD100.
  3.
Please do NOT write about Durham in Canada. Instead, you can use GTA.
  4.
We do not accept link insertions or exchanges.
  5.
General Post: USD 150
  6.
General Promo/Advert Post (focused on company, product or service): USD 250
  7.
Non-casino Grey Niche Post: USD 350
  8.
Non-casino Grey Niche Promo/Advert Post (focused on company, product or service): USD 400
  9.
You can buy Ad Space directly at https://durhampost.ca/shop
  10.
Payment via Bank Transfer or PayPal after live link submission is acceptable.
  11.
We have a Fixed Price Policy

Looking forward to hearing from you.
Wish you a wonderful day!
Eudore
Editor

=== Message 2 ===
From: "Московский отдел Компартии" <kprf@inbox.ru>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 17:53:38 +0300
Subject: Re: Заинтересованность в сотрудничестве с вашим сайтом prikol.ru


Олег, добрый день!
 
Мы принимаем к размещению рекламные посты. 
 
Условия размещения следующие:
Вы самостоятельно готовите статью + стартующую картинку к ней.
Желательно не превышать лимит на количество знаков в статье — 1500.
Допускается до двух ссылок из тела статьи.
Статья размещается в индексируемом разделе сайта и остаётся там навсегда.
Так же желательно делать текст читаемым, то есть разбитым на абзацы с подзаголовками
 
ВАЖНО:
1. Размещение происходит только после оплаты
2. Сайт не может быть закрытым и должен быть доступен к просмотру контента
3. В случае получения предписания от РКН об удалении страницы с размещённой статьей, страница удаляется
4. Короткие ссылки, а так же редиректы с одного домена на другой, к размещению не принимаются. В случае обнаружения —  удаляются. 
5. В случае принятия данного закона, все статьи попадающие под его действие, будут удалены с сайта:  https://ria.ru/20250819/pravitelstvo-2036209238.html
6. Ссылки в размещенных ранее статьях, не заменяются (исключением является — замена ссылки в рамках одного домена)
7. Старые статьи с неактивными/битыми ссылками — с сайта удаляются
8. Деньги при возникновении ситуаций описанных в пп 3, 4, 5, 7 — не возвращаются.
 
Оплата:
5000р на карту Сбера.
+25% за размещение нестандартных тематик
 
Обратите внимание:
ДО ОПЛАТЫ! Необходимо получить подтверждение, что ваше размещение согласовано! 
 
С уважением,
Александр

Subject: Using Cursor's Agent
Messages: 1

=== Message 1 ===
From: Cursor Team <hi@mail.cursor.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 08:02:00 +0000

Cursor

Cursor Agent ( https://cursor.com/docs/agent/overview ) can take on complex coding tasks, such as creating features or fixing bugs end-to-end. You can use it in the sidepane with Cmd/Ctrl-I.

To get the most out of Agent, here are some tips:

*
Use “@” in your prompt ( https://cursor.com/docs/context/symbols#definitions ) to pull in specific context, such as specific files, websites, and git branches.
*
If you want to jump backwards in the Agent’s history, you can use checkpoints ( https://cursor.com/docs/agent/chat/checkpoints ) to revert changes.
*
Agent can run shell commands ( https://cursor.com/docs/agent/terminal ) as it works. You can also define command execution ( https://cursor.com/docs/agent/terminal#command-execution-modes ) rules.
*
With rules ( https://cursor.com/docs/context/rules#rules ) and /commands ( https://cursor.com/docs/agent/chat/commands ), you can configure system-level instructions and reusable workflows.
*
With cloud agents ( https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent ), you can spawn asynchronous agents that edit and run code in a remote environment.
- Cursor Team

** 📊 Fact of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

The team at Peec AI (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/landwehr_i-recently-wrote-about-how-chatgpt-fanout-share-7421889497451352064-rU12?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzOvD0Bmz54f11nNaIvBvI5B6rpx53pn00&utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=c5e792a8f2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_12_18_25_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-c5e792a8f2-1449626676) looked at the average word count for ChatGPT query fanout.

Right now, it sits at about 12 words on average.

🧐 Why should you care?

If you are looking to show up in AI results, you can’t chase traditional keywords.

This shows that if ChatGPT doesn’t have an answer in its training data, it will search the web. On average, the searches they are doing are 12 words long.

💡 What should you do about it?

The prevailing thought is to try to create content that meets the queries.

The problem is that these queries change based on the types of prompts, personal browsing history, and other features.

(Mike King covers this all here (https://ipullrank.com/how-ai-mode-works?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=c5e792a8f2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_12_18_25_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-c5e792a8f2-1449626676) .)

Ultimately, I don’t think we know enough to make any drastic calls on this, but data like average query size from Peec AI gets us closer to understanding.


** 🐝 Tip of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------

This week’s Tip of the Week comes from Robyn Munro (https://www.linkedin.com/in/robynmunroo/?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=c5e792a8f2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_12_18_25_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-c5e792a8f2-1449626676) , Digital PR Manager at Vega Comms (https://www.vegacomms.co.uk/?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=c5e792a8f2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_12_18_25_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-c5e792a8f2-1449626676) , sharing her expertise on working with journalists when interviewing celebrities to guarantee coverage.


** Using Journalists to secure exclusive questions (and guarantee coverage) when interviewing celebrities
------------------------------------------------------------

When you’re interviewing a celebrity or talent, exclusive questions can be more powerful than exclusive access, if they’re handled correctly.

Instead of pitching finished interviews, PRs can work with journalists to shape coverage before it exists.

How to use exclusives strategically:


** ✅ Identify the right journalist before securing quotes
------------------------------------------------------------

Match the celebrity, topic, and publication early. This increases buy-in and reduces the risk of unused content.


** ✅ Invite journalists to submit exclusive questions
------------------------------------------------------------

Offering a journalist the chance to shape the interview gives them editorial ownership – and a strong incentive to publish.

If they can’t join the call or interview live, offer to ask their questions on their behalf so they still secure exclusive insight and usable quotes.

This builds trust in your rapport with the journalist, shows you respect their editorial priorities, and helps strengthen long-term relationships beyond a single piece of coverage.


** ✅ Agree on the exclusivity upfront
------------------------------------------------------------

Be clear on timing, embargoes, and usage to avoid confusion or broken trust.


** ✅ Build the story angle collaboratively
------------------------------------------------------------

Share the wider context of the interview so journalists can frame coverage around their audience’s interests.

—

Vince’s take:

When we talk about building relationships with journalists, this kind of attention and care is required—especially in a world where journalists are overloaded with garbagey, generic pitches.

Thanks, Robyn!

** 3. Dating and Politics
------------------------------------------------------------

🔗 Source (https://hily.com/data/politics-dating-in-america-breakup-day-yet-to-come/?utm_source=BuzzStream+Mailer&utm_campaign=c5e792a8f2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_12_18_25_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_0e868c52d2-c5e792a8f2-1449626676)

Dating app Hily conducted a survey last year on political dealbreakers for daters.

I often tell people to think of ideation as an equation because it helps solidify their angles.

Politics + Dating/Relationships gives you two solid outreach markets to target with something like this, and it landed them coverage on BuzzFeed, HuffPo, and others.

Да, это возможно без явной рекламы и призыву к действию. Прикреплю пример:
ссылка
<https://metaratings.ru/stavki/kto-smenit-yurgena-kloppa-v-liverpule-kto-stanet-trenerom-liverpulya-imena-kandidatov/>

Предлагаем сотрудничество в рамках изданий:

   -

   BroDude <http://brodude.ru/> – один из самых читаемых мужских журналов в
   рунете (более 1 млн. прочтений ежемесячно). Аудитория: мужчины 60%, ядро
   25-40 лет.
   -

   Героиня <https://heroine.ru/> – журнал для целеустремленных женщин
   (более 500 тыс. прочтений ежемесячно). Аудитория: женщины 70%, ядро 25-40
   лет.
   -

   Hussle <https://hussle.ru/> – бизнес-издание (более 200 тыс. прочтений
   ежемесячно). Аудитория: мужчины 80%, ядро 30-45 лет.
   -

   Royal Cheese <https://royalcheese.ru/> – интеллектуальное медиа о
   культуре и обществе (более 400 тыс. прочтений ежемесячно). У журнала
   активная аудитория, которая «живет» в интернете, следит за новыми трендами.
   Аудитория: мужчины/женщины 50%, ядро 22-35 лет.

При заказе цикла материалов в январе действует скидка:

- цикл из 4 статей = 180 000 руб.

- цикл из 2 статей = 100 000  руб.

*(стоимость 1 статьи по прайсу = 60 000 руб).


Буду ждать от вас обратную связь)

Subject: Re: Заинтересованность в сотрудничестве с вашим сайтом vsplanet.net

Добрый день.Большое спасибо за ваше обращение. Если вкратце, то статьи размещаем на практически любую тематику.Размещение статьи стоит 5000 рублей (или же 85 долларов)Жестких требований нет. Вы можете выбрать как тематику, так и язык публикации. Это необязательно должен быть русский язык.Примеры размещения:на русском языке: https://vsplanet.net/?p=5783на украинском: https://vsplanet.net/?p=18583на азербайджанском: https://vsplanet.net/?p=16449 Внутри одной статьи должно быть не больше двух ссылок, и все ссылки должны быть на один домен (возможно на разные страницы). Если вы направите HTML-версию статьи, это упростит и убыстрит публикацию, но обязательным это не является. Статьи индексируемые, никаких пометок "реклама" или тому подобных, публикация будет в обычной новостной рубрике, с прохождением через главную страницу и сохранением на сайте минимум на 3 года, максимум - навсегда. Мы также можем написать статью сами, сделав ее в стиле сайта и добавив ваши ссылки. Эта опция стоит 2500 (40 долларов) рублей за материал в +/-2000 знаков. Все публикуется только после согласования с вами. Пример такой статьи: https://vsplanet.net/?p=13097 Увы, участились случаи, когда присылают откровенно переводной, не отредактированный или фейковый контент из ИИ. Поэтому если вы решите написать статью в стилистике сайта самостоятельно, мы вынуждены будем проставить условие обязательной смысловой редактуры - 1000 рублей за одну статью (18 долларов). Это сверка лексики, актуальности информации и нейтрализация возможных огрехов перевода или искусственной генерации текста. Процедура обычно такова: присланную вами статью забираю в черновики, ожидаю прохождения оплаты, после чего публикую в открытом пространстве сайта. Если вам важно сначала провести оплату, - вы может прислать статью позже. Если вам нужно подтверждение публикации ДО проведения оплаты, это можно организовать за дополнительно 300 рублей (6 долларов). Мы также готовы рассмотреть варианты размещения рекламных баннеров и ссылок в том числе на главной странице. Если вам интересен подобный вариант спонсорства, готов прислать опции. Для оплаты есть карты российских банков, есть СБП, есть донатерские сервисы, также функционирует криптокошелек. Благодарю за обращениес уважением,АлексейVSplanet.net ----------------Кому: support@vsplanet.net (support@vsplanet.net);Тема: Заинтересованность в сотрудничестве с вашим сайтом vsplanet.net;27.01.2026, 12:38, "Oleg Tsebulevkiy" <o.tsebulevsky@rantsports.com>:Здравствуйте!Меня зовут Олег и я пишу вам от имени компании Metaratings.Рассматриваете ли вы возможность сотрудничества в публикации сторонних статей на вашем веб-сайте?Если да, то я хотел бы услышать ваши условия для этого сотрудничества.Олег | Контент-менеджер, Metaratings

=== Message 1 ===
From: "Отдел рекламы" <utro@brest.by>
Date: Tue, 27 Jan 2026 16:48:39 +0300

Добрый день!

Размещение статей на нашем сайте стоит 132 руб. (ссылка dofollow), 66 руб. (ссылка nofollow). Условие размещение-предоплата. Для размещения нам нужен текст, реквизиты для выставления счета, свидетельство госрегистрации. 

Это может быть статья, пресс-релиз, новость, если она соответствует нашему региону и тематике газеты, сео материал, гэмблинг-нет, если речь о ставках. Статьи должны соответствовать законодательству РБ, реклама не указывается, если по ссылке идет выход на сайт, если нет выхода, то указывается УНП юрлица (ваше либо рекламодателя). Естественно статьи на гос. языках РБ-белорусский и русский. По объему ограничений нет, приблизительно 2500 знаков, и не более 2-3 ссылок в тексте, количество фото около 3. 

Так как статьи о ставках редко соответствуют Закону РБ о рекламе, для начала высылайте текст статьи, которую хотите размещать.

 

С уважением, отдел маркетинга и рекламы Брестской областной газеты «Заря», Светлана

т/ф. 20-04-11, т.8029-249-04-11 (вайбер)
